name: io.github.jokeks2023/huly-mcp-selfhost
description: MCP server for Huly (self-hosted + cloud): projects, issues, milestones, documents, chat and more.

environmentVariables.name: HULY_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Huly account email (option A, together with HULY_PASSWORD)

environmentVariables.name: HULY_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Huly token for SSO accounts without a password (option B, get it via `npx huly-mcp-setup`)

environmentVariables.name: HULY_ACCOUNTS_URL
environmentVariables.description: Account service URL for self-hosted Huly. Default: https://account.huly.app

environmentVariables.name: HULY_FRONT_URL
environmentVariables.description: Front URL of your Huly instance, enables document/description content and uploads

environmentVariables.name: HULY_WORKSPACE
environmentVariables.description: Optional: restrict the server to one workspace (slug, name or id)
